mapper.select: SELECT ad.approval_document_id, ad.document_type, ad.title, ad.status_code, TO_CHAR(ad.submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS submitted_at, e.employee_name, d.department_name, lr.requested_days, b.branch_name, CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS my_turn, (SELECT MIN(x.leave_type) FROM leave_request_day x WHERE x.company_id = ad.company_id AND x.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id) AS f_leave_type, (SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(x.leave_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM leave_request_day x WHERE x.company_id = ad.company_id AND x.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id) AS f_from_date, (SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(x.leave_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM leave_request_day x WHERE x.company_id = ad.company_id AND x.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id) AS f_to_date, lr.reason AS f_reason, er.asset_type AS f_asset_type, er.quantity AS f_quantity, er.branch_id AS f_branch_id, er.purpose AS f_purpose FROM approval_document ad JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = ad.company_id AND e.employee_id = ad.author_employee_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.company_id = e.company_id AND d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN leave_request lr ON lr.company_id = ad.company_id AND lr.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id LEFT JOIN equipment_request er ON er.company_id = ad.company_id AND er.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id LEFT JOIN branch b ON b.company_id = er.company_id AND b.branch_id = er.branch_id WHERE ORDER BY ad.submitted_at DESC, ad.approval_document_id DESC

SELECT s.approval_document_id, s.approver_employee_id, e.employee_name, s.status_code FROM approval_step s JOIN approval_document ad ON ad.company_id = s.company_id AND ad.approval_document_id = s.approval_document_id JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = s.company_id AND e.employee_id = s.approver_employee_id WHERE ORDER BY s.approval_document_id, s.step_no

SELECT h.approval_document_id, TO_CHAR(h.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, e.employee_name, h.action_code, h.opinion FROM approval_history h JOIN approval_document ad ON ad.company_id = h.company_id AND ad.approval_document_id = h.approval_document_id LEFT JOIN user_account ua ON ua.company_id = h.company_id AND ua.user_account_id = h.actor_account_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = ua.company_id AND e.employee_id = ua.employee_id WHERE ORDER BY h.approval_document_id, h.created_at, h.approval_history_id
